text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho didn't show up for training
today so I've been searching everywhere
for her. The sun is
starting to set when I
finally find her in the library.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh, Familiar. What're you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
choice_data_list: Weren't we supposed to train today?
We were supposed to have training ...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I-It's not like I forgot! I've just been
really busy
practicing magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hold on! I'll just use magic to reverse
time back to
before training starts!
That'll definitely work!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Turn back already! C'mon! Philadelphus
reversal!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can tell she's sorry by how desperately
she's
trying to use magic, so I let her off
with a warning.
